question: Given Deere's updated fiscal 2026 net income guidance from its Q3 release, what Q4 FY2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company is implied at the low and high ends?
grading: Implied Q4 low/high ±$10M, USD millions; must use the nine-month YTD figure and updated (not prior) guidance range
answer: Deere’s updated FY2026 net-income-attributable-to-Deere guide is USD 4,750–5,000 million. Subtract nine-month attributable net income of USD 3,808 million: implied Q4 FY2026 attributable net income is USD 942 million at the low end and USD 1,192 million at the high end. These are derived outlook amounts, not reported Q4 actuals. [G22-E1]

output.answer:
**Question:** Given Deere's updated fiscal 2026 net income guidance from its Q3 release, what Q4 FY2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company is implied at the low and high ends?
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Implied net income attributable to Deere & Company (USD millions) |
|---|---|
| Q4 FY2026 (quarter ending 2026-11-01) — low end of guidance | 942 [1][2] |
| Q4 FY2026 (quarter ending 2026-11-01) — high end of guidance | 1,192 [1][2] |

- Deere's Q3 FY2026 earnings release (8-K EX-99.1, filed 2026-08-20) states that net income attributable to Deere & Company for fiscal 2026 is forecasted to be in a range of $4.75 billion to $5.00 billion, an increase from prior guidance. [1]
- The same release reports GAAP net income attributable to Deere & Company of $3.808 billion for the first nine months of fiscal 2026 (nine months ended August 2, 2026), which is the actual base from which the implied Q4 residual is derived. [1][2]
- The implied Q4 FY2026 (quarter ending November 1, 2026) net income attributable to Deere & Company at the low end of guidance is 942 million, calculated as the low end of the fiscal 2026 guidance minus the nine-month actual. [1][2]
- The implied Q4 FY2026 (quarter ending November 1, 2026) net income attributable to Deere & Company at the high end of guidance is 1,192 million, calculated as the high end of the fiscal 2026 guidance minus the nine-month actual. [1][2]
- The guidance and the nine-month actual are both stated on the same basis — GAAP net income attributable to Deere & Company — so the residual ties to reported GAAP net income; the release presents no adjusted or non-GAAP net income guidance for fiscal 2026. [1][3]

**Not available**
- Actual Q4 FY2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company: Q4 FY2026 (2026-08-03 to 2026-11-01) is still in progress; Deere's Q4 FY2026 earnings call is scheduled for 25 November 2026, so no actual Q4 result exists in the evidence. [3]

**Sources**
[1] DEERE & CO earnings release for Q3 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-08-20) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-20, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/315189/000110465926098904/de-20260820xex99d1.htm
[2] DEERE & CO 10-Q for Q3 FY2026 (filed 2026-08-27) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-27, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/315189/000110465926102213/de-20260802x10q.htm
[3] DEERE & CO earnings release for Q3 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.2 (filed 2026-08-20) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-20, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/315189/000110465926098904/de-20260820xex99d2.htm

The Q3 FY2026 earnings release (8-K filed 2026-08-20) is the source of the updated FY2026 net income guidance; the Q3 FY2026 10-Q (filed 2026-08-27) provides the nine-month year-to-date net income attributable to Deere & Company.

If the guidance is expressed on a different basis than GAAP net income attributable to Deere (e.g., adjusted/continuing operations, or excluding certain items), the implied Q4 residual will not tie exactly to reported GAAP net income; the release's reconciliation and footnotes should be checked.
